title: Policy Considerations for Long-term Population Growth
what_it_is: Policy Considerations for Long-term Population Growth

sections.label: Population, citizenship and PR trends
sections.summary: Singapore's total population is likely to be significantly below 6.9 million by 2030, with resident TFR at 1.14 in 2019 and average annual grants of about 22,100 citizenships and 31,700 PRs over five years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: In March 2018, we updated Parliament that given recent trends, Singapore’s total population size is likely to be significantly below 6.9 million by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Our most recent resident TFR, for 2019, was 1.14, unchanged from the year before.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: To the Member’s question on annual new citizens, over the past five years, we granted an average of about 22,100 new Singapore Citizenships each year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: This included about 1,600 children born overseas to Singaporean parents every year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We also granted about 31,700 new PRs on average each year, over the past five years.

sections.label: Singaporeans aged 65 and above
sections.summary: About 15% of Singaporeans were aged 65 and above last year, and this will increase to around 25% by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Last year, about 15% of Singaporeans were aged 65 and above.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: By 2030, this will increase to around 25%.

sections.label: Healthcare spending share of GDP
sections.summary: Average annual healthcare spending is expected to rise from 2.1% of GDP today to almost 3% of GDP over the next decade.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: For example, the average annual healthcare spending is expected to rise from 2.1% of GDP today to almost 3% of GDP over the next decade.

sections.label: Personal income tax revenue share
sections.summary: The share of personal income tax of tax revenue remained at about 18% from FY2016 to FY2018.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The share of personal income tax or PIT, of our tax revenue has remained at about 18% from FY2016 to FY2018.
